title: Lord Jim
summary: "Lord Jim" by Joseph Conrad is a novel originally published as a serial from 1899 to 1900. Haunted by shame, Jim flees from port to port until finding refuge in a remote island village, where he becomes a respected leader called "Lord Jim."
